title: Karla Turner's abductees describe a control system run from a metallic sphere (the Moon)

tellings.quote: where they said that we are in a control system that's being managed from out of a metallic sphere just beyond the earth.

plain: People who said they had been abducted by aliens told the writer Karla Turner in the 1990s that humans live inside a control system run from a metallic sphere just beyond the Earth, which the story takes to be the Moon. The researcher Jason Jorjani repeats this from Turner's work, linking it to the writer Robert Monroe and his book Far Journeys. If true, something off-world would be steering human life.
